description: Track private-company funding rounds from SEC Form D and Form C filings, funding newswires and investor portfolio pages. Look up a company's rounds and backers, build investor profiles, or monitor only new rounds since the last run.

companies.description: Company names, domains or Crunchbase URLs (mode=companyLookup). Each is searched on SEC EDGAR for the last five years plus recent funding news. Maximum 20 per run.
companies.sectionDescription: Use companyLookup to return every known round and its backers for named companies.
companies.title: Companies to look up

country.description: Country name or common alias, for example United States, UK or India. Records without a detected country pass through.
country.title: Country

enrichNewsPages.description: Fetch news article pages to fill the company domain and a longer description.
enrichNewsPages.title: Enrich news article pages

fromDate.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to use lookbackDays.
fromDate.title: From date

includeNews.description: Read PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, Business Wire, AccessWire and Google News funding feeds, then parse round type, amount, currency, lead and participating investors.
includeNews.title: Include funding newswires

includeRelatedPersons.description: Add executives, directors and promoters from Form D filings (name, title, city and state).
includeRelatedPersons.sectionDescription: Optional detail that adds more fields or fetches article pages. Turn both off for the cheapest run.
includeRelatedPersons.title: Include Form D related persons

includeSecFormC.description: Query SEC EDGAR for Regulation Crowdfunding Form C / C-A offerings and read the issuer, security type, offering amount, deadline and financial summary.
includeSecFormC.title: Include SEC Form C crowdfunding

includeSecFormD.description: Query SEC EDGAR full-text search and read each Form D / D/A filing XML: issuer, industry, entity type, jurisdiction, offering amounts, investors, exemptions and related persons.
includeSecFormD.title: Include SEC Form D

industry.description: Industry inferred from SEC industry groups and newswire text. Records with no inferred industry pass through.
industry.title: Industry

investorGeography.description: Country or region text, for example United States or Europe. Matched against observed deal geographies and firm headquarters.
investorGeography.title: Investor geography filter

investorSector.description: Keep investors with at least one observed deal in this sector.
investorSector.title: Investor sector filter

investorStage.description: Keep investors with at least one observed deal at this stage.
investorStage.title: Investor stage filter

investors.description: VC firm or angel names (mode=investorLookup). Firms in the built-in directory also get live portfolio and team pages. Leave empty with a filter to discover investors from recent rounds.
investors.sectionDescription: Named firms get portfolio and team pages; every investor gets deal statistics from the rounds observed in the same run.
investors.title: Investors to look up

lookbackDays.description: Days back from today when fromDate is empty. Ignored when fromDate is set.
lookbackDays.title: Lookback window (days)

maxAmount.description: Maximum announced or sold amount in USD. Non-USD rounds and rounds without an amount pass through.
maxAmount.title: Maximum amount (USD)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (1-500). SEC filing XML enrichment is capped at 400 filings per run.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxRoundsPerCompany.description: Cap on rounds emitted for each company in companyLookup mode.
maxRoundsPerCompany.title: Max rounds per company

minAmount.description: Minimum announced or sold amount in USD. Non-USD rounds and rounds without an amount pass through.
minAmount.title: Minimum amount (USD)

minDeals.description: Keep investors with at least this many deals in the run's observed rounds. Investors with no observed deals pass through.
minDeals.title: Minimum observed deals

mode.description: What to collect: funded companies in a date window, every known round for named companies, investor profiles, or only rounds that are new since the previous run.
mode.sectionDescription: Choose a mode, the sources to query, and the reporting window. The daily prefill uses SEC Form D only for the smallest reliable run.
mode.title: Mode

monitorReset.description: Ignore previously seen rounds for this run and replace the saved state with what this run emits.
monitorReset.title: Reset monitor state

monitorStateKey.description: Separate saved state for each watchlist (mode=monitor). Use different keys for different filters.
monitorStateKey.sectionDescription: Monitor mode remembers round identities in the actor's key-value store and emits only rounds that were not seen before.
monitorStateKey.title: Monitor state key

roundType.description: Keep one funding stage. Leave as any to include every stage.
roundType.title: Round type

searchQuery.description: Optional free-text filter for company names, descriptions, industries, round types and investors (all modes). Also used as the SEC full-text query and news search term.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Filters apply to rounds from every source. A record that does not publish a field passes that filter.
searchQuery.title: Search keywords

state.description: Optional US state filter. Useful for SEC issuer addresses and US datelines.
state.title: US state

toDate.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
toDate.title: To date

title: Funding Rounds Tracker Input
